summary: Amass Brands filed an 8-K to report an amendment to an existing warrant held by Streeterville Capital, LLC. The amendment temporarily reduces the exercise price to $1.50 per share for 30 days, after which it reverts to $16.00 per share. All other warrant terms remain unchanged. This is a routine contractual modification to a financing instrument, not a special situation. There are no merger, divestiture, or corporate action elements. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a standard disclosure of a material definitive agreement with no transformative event.
